threats.threat_description: An attacker captures and replays or forges RF response messages pretending to be a legitimate key fob, exploiting the external wireless interface to unlock doors or start the vehicle without authorization.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Key Fob shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, and Integrity of RF Challenge-Response Messages and Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and starting.

threats.threat_description: Side-channel leakage or interception of cryptographic keys or authentication exchanges from the key fob’s wireless transmissions, potentially allowing attackers to clone or derive key material.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Key Fob shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of RF Challenge-Response Messages and Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0038: Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and starting.

threats.threat_description: An attacker jams or floods the RF channel preventing the key fob from communicating with the vehicle, denying entry or engine start.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Key Fob shall ensure the Availability of RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent user lockout and inability to start the vehicle.

threats.threat_description: Physical tampering or manipulation of the LF antenna to generate false proximity signals, causing unauthorized unlocking or triggering undesired authentication flows.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Antenna (Door Handle) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of LF Proximity Signal against ATM-T0004: Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or initiation of authentication processes.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Physical Penetration Testing / Signal Integrity Analysis

threats.threat_description: An attacker generates spoofed LF wake-up signals to trick the vehicle into initiating challenge-response exchanges, potentially increasing attack surface and enabling relay or replay attacks.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Antenna (Door Handle) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the LF Proximity Signal against ATM-T0004: Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent unauthorized initiation of authentication flows and increased risk of vehicle entry or start.

threats.threat_description: An attacker blocks or jams the LF antenna signals to prevent detection of the key fob’s proximity, denying legitimate user access.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Antenna (Door Handle) shall ensure the Availability of the LF Proximity Signal against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent denial of access for legitimate users.

threats.threat_description: Physical tampering with the vehicle RF antenna or its connections to perform antenna spoofing, signal amplification, or relay attacks, enabling attackers to extend effective range or intercept signals.
linked_assets: RF Transceiver -> Vehicle Antenna RF Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Vehicle RF Antenna shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability of the RF Transceiver to Vehicle Antenna RF Link against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking, starting, and interception of authentication exchanges.

threats.threat_description: An attacker with physical access to the RF antenna may eavesdrop on RF transmissions, gaining access to challenge-response messages and potentially facilitating replay or cryptanalysis.
linked_assets: RF Transceiver -> Vehicle Antenna RF Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Vehicle RF Antenna shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of the Vehicle Antenna RF Link against ATM-T0038: Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized access to challenge-response messages and compromise of the authentication process.

threats.threat_description: An attacker physically disconnects or damages the RF antenna, preventing communication between the vehicle and key fob and denying access or engine start.
linked_assets: RF Transceiver -> Vehicle Antenna RF Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Vehicle RF Antenna shall enforce the Availability of the Vehicle Antenna RF Link against Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent loss of keyless entry and engine start functionality.

threats.threat_description: An attacker compromises the RF transceiver firmware (I7) or exploits lack of authentication on the BCM->RF control interface (C9) to inject forged challenge or response messages, impersonating the vehicle or key fob.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of RF Challenge-Response Messages and the Availability of the BCM -> RF Transceiver Control Interface against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking, starting, or immobilization.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Interface Fuzzing / Firmware Integrity Verification

threats.threat_description: Modification or compromise of the RF transceiver firmware to alter or drop forwarded authentication data (I5), enabling bypass of authentication or denial of legitimate responses.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Auth Data and RF Transceiver Firmware against Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized vehicle access or immobilization.

threats.threat_description: Compromise of the RF transceiver firmware leading to leakage of cryptographic response data or internal vehicle messages received at the transceiver.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall protect the Confidentiality, Authenticity, and Integrity of Auth Data and RF Transceiver Firmware against ATM-T0022: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized disclosure of cryptographic response data and internal vehicle messages.

threats.threat_description: An attacker jams the RF transceiver or exploits firmware vulnerabilities to cause it to drop or delay legitimate RF messages, blocking authentication or vehicle access.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of RF Challenge-Response Messages and Auth Data against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent unauthorized blocking of vehicle access or operation.

threats.threat_description: An attacker injects forged or replayed analog RF waveforms on the data flow DF15 (RF_1 -> ANT_RF_1), manipulating the transmitted signals to the vehicle RF antenna to spoof challenges or responses, enabling unauthorized access or relay attacks.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Confidentiality of the data flow RF_1 -> ANT_RF_1 against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking, starting, or relay attacks.

threats.threat_description: Physical tampering or manipulation of the analog RF waveform data flow DF15 (RF_1 -> ANT_RF_1) including antenna cable cutting, signal injection, or alteration, which may disrupt or spoof the RF communication between the transceiver and vehicle antenna.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Availability, Integrity, and Authenticity of the RF_1 -> ANT_RF_1 data flow against ATM-T0004: Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent disruption or unauthorized manipulation of RF-based vehicle functions.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Physical Penetration Test / Signal Integrity Analysis

threats.threat_description: Eavesdropping on the analog RF waveform flow DF15 (RF_1 -> ANT_RF_1) by physically tapping the antenna cable or RF feed, allowing attackers to capture raw RF signals and analyze challenge-response exchanges.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of RF_1 -> ANT_RF_1 against ATM-T0038: Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized capture and analysis of challenge-response exchanges leading to replay or relay attacks.

threats.threat_description: Jamming or physically blocking the analog RF waveform data flow DF15 (RF_1 -> ANT_RF_1) to prevent transmission of challenge or response signals, denying authentication and vehicle access.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Availability of the RF_1 -> ANT_RF_1 analog RF signal path against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent legitimate users from being denied vehicle access or start functionality.

threats.threat_description: An attacker injects or manipulates the received RF waveform on data flow DF16 (ANT_RF_1 -> RF_1), sending fabricated or replayed signals to the RF transceiver to impersonate the key fob or initiate unauthorized authentication sequences.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the ANT_RF_1 -> RF_1 data flow against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or starting.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Protocol Fuzzing / Interface Analysis

threats.threat_description: Physical or electronic tampering with the data flow DF16 (ANT_RF_1 -> RF_1), such as cable cutting, signal distortion, or noise injection, to disrupt or manipulate the received RF waveform and prevent correct demodulation of key fob responses.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Availability and Integrity of the analog data flow between ANT_RF_1 and RF_1 against ATM-T0004: Analog Sensor Attacks to prevent denial of keyless entry/start or unpredictable system behavior.

threats.threat_description: Intercepting or measuring the received RF waveform on data flow DF16 (ANT_RF_1 -> RF_1) through physical access to antenna or RF front-end, leaking sensitive signal characteristics or challenge-response information aiding cryptanalysis or relay attacks.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of data on data flow DF16 (ANT_RF_1 -> RF_1) against ATM-T0038: Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized access to cryptographic material or challenge-response exchanges that could enable cryptanalysis or relay attacks.

threats.threat_description: Blocking or jamming the received RF waveform data flow DF16 (ANT_RF_1 -> RF_1), preventing the RF transceiver from correctly receiving key fob responses and causing denial of authentication and vehicle access.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of the RF data flow (ANT_RF_1 -> RF_1) against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent denial of authentication and vehicle access for authorized users.

threats.threat_description: An attacker with physical access to the vehicle's RF transceiver can connect to its debug or JTAG interface to extract sensitive cryptographic keys and challenge-response credentials stored in memory. By exploiting this developer interface, the attacker can exfiltrate secret data used for secure communications over data flow DF16 (ANT_RF_1 -> RF_1). This exposed information enables cryptanalysis or facilitates relay attacks, compromising the confidentiality and integrity of the RF communication.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver (Vehicle) shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of cryptographic keys and challenge-response credentials against ATM-T0073: Physical Access to prevent unauthorized vehicle access or control via compromised RF communications.

threats.threat_description: An attacker compromises the BCM firmware or configuration (I3, I9) to impersonate the BCM, issuing unauthorized door unlock or engine start commands without proper authentication.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of BCM Firmware, Configuration, and CAN Lock/Unlock Messages against Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking, engine starting, and potential theft.

threats.threat_description: Tampering with BCM firmware or configuration to disable or bypass authentication checks, enabling unauthorized unlocking or engine start commands to be issued over the CAN bus.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Firmware, Configuration, and Access Policies against ATM-T0022: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized unlocking or starting of the vehicle via CAN messages.

threats.threat_description: Inadequate logging or use of tokens without non-repudiation may allow an attacker or compromised BCM to deny having sent unlock or start commands.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Accountability of CAN Lock/Unlock Messages and Start Authorization Tokens against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized lock/unlock or start commands being issued without traceable origin.

threats.threat_description: Compromise of BCM configuration or firmware (I3, I9) could expose cryptographic keys, tokens, or authentication data, aiding attackers in bypassing security.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Firmware, Configuration Data, and Start Authorization Tokens against ATM-T0039: ECU Credential Dumping to prevent unauthorized vehicle start and disabling of immobilizer functions.
cybersecurity_goal.functional_boundary: In-Vehicle / Diagnostic and Firmware Update Interfaces
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Firmware and Interface Security Analysis

threats.threat_description: An attacker floods or jams the BCM with invalid LF wake signals (from LF_RX_1 or ANT_1) or RF responses, causing repeated challenge flows and draining vehicle battery or denying legitimate access.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Availability of LF Proximity Signal and RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent battery drain and denial of legitimate vehicle access.

threats.threat_description: A compromised BCM firmware or configuration allows an attacker to escalate privileges, bypassing the restricted HSM API access controls to extract or misuse cryptographic keys or generate unauthorized tokens.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Confidentiality, Integrity, Authenticity, and Availability of Restricted HSM API and BCM Configuration and Access Policies against ATM-T0024: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism to prevent unauthorized extraction or misuse of cryptographic keys and generation of unauthorized tokens.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Firmware Analysis / Access Control Validation

threats.threat_description: An attacker intercepts and modifies CAN lock/unlock messages (DF4) sent from the BCM to the Door ECU to issue unauthorized door commands or prevent legitimate commands.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of lock/unlock command messages sent to the Door ECU against Modify Bus Message to prevent unauthorized vehicle access or denial of legitimate locking and unlocking.

threats.threat_description: An attacker intercepts and modifies CAN start authorization messages (DF5) from the BCM to the Start Authorization ECU, potentially enabling unauthorized engine starts or blocking legitimate starts.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of start authorization messages between BCM and Start Authorization ECU against ATM-T0070: Modify Bus Message to prevent unauthorized engine starts or denial of legitimate vehicle operation.

threats.threat_description: An attacker forges unlock commands with authorization tokens sent over CAN (DF11), impersonating the BCM to unlock doors without proper authentication.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of unlock command messages on the BCM_1 -> ECU_DOOR data flow against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized unlocking of vehicle doors.

threats.threat_description: An attacker blocks or jams the BCM to Door ECU CAN messages (DF4, DF11), denying door lock/unlock functionality.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of Door Lock/Unlock Command Messages against CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent loss of electronic door locking and unlocking functionality.

threats.threat_description: An attacker blocks or jams the BCM to Start Authorization ECU CAN messages (DF5, DF13), denying engine start authorization.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of Start Authorization CAN messages against CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent unauthorized prevention of vehicle starting.

threats.threat_description: An attacker compromises the BCM to RF Transceiver control interface (DF14), modifying or injecting challenge payloads to manipulate the authentication process or cause denial of service.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the BCM to RF Transceiver communication against Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle access, bypass of authentication, or denial of service.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Interface Fuzzing / Communication Integrity Verification

threats.threat_description: An attacker blocks or jams the LF wake/proximity event flow (DF17) from the LF Receiver to the BCM, preventing the vehicle from detecting key fob proximity and denying access.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Availability of LF wake/proximity event flow between the LF Receiver and the BCM against Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent user lockout and inability to start the vehicle.

threats.threat_description: An attacker exploits weaknesses in the Body Control Module's firmware verification process to install a modified firmware version that lacks integrity checks. This unauthorized firmware disables authentication mechanisms, allowing the adversary to send forged CAN lock/unlock messages and start commands without detection, effectively bypassing code integrity protections.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Integrity and Authenticity of Firmware and CAN Lock/Unlock Messages against ATM-T0031: Bypass Code Integrity Protections to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking, starting, and persistent compromise of anti-theft controls.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Firmware Update Process Review

threats.threat_description: An attacker sends forged CAN lock/unlock messages to the Door ECU over the in-vehicle CAN bus, attempting to unlock doors without valid authorization tokens.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of CAN Lock/Unlock Messages against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized unlocking of doors and potential vehicle theft.

threats.threat_description: Modification of Door ECU firmware or configuration to disable token verification or accept any command, enabling unauthorized door unlocking.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Door Lock/Unlock Command against ATM-T0022: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized unlocking of vehicle doors and potential theft or unauthorized entry.

threats.threat_description: Lack of logging or audit trails in Door ECU may allow denial by attackers or compromised devices of having issued unlock commands.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Accountability and Authenticity of CAN Lock/Unlock Message against ATM-T0069: Local Function to prevent inability to attribute unauthorized unlock events and hinder incident response and accountability.

threats.threat_description: An attacker floods the Door ECU with CAN messages or physically disables the Door Lock Actuator, preventing legitimate locking or unlocking.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Availability and Integrity of CAN Lock/Unlock Message and Door ECU -> Actuator Signal against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent vehicle doors from being left unlocked or locked, resulting in unauthorized access or obstructed entry/exit.

threats.threat_description: An attacker intercepts and modifies the actuator command data flow (DF9) from the Door ECU to the Door Lock Actuator to prevent door locking or unlocking.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Integrity, Availability, and Authenticity of actuator command data flow (DF9) to the Door Lock Actuator against Modify Bus Message to prevent unauthorized prevention of door locking or unlocking.

threats.threat_description: Physical or logical blocking of the actuator command flow (DF9) or jamming the actuator itself to deny door locking or unlocking.
threats.atm_technique_name: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Availability and Integrity of the Door Actuator command flow against Denial of Service on Vehicle Function to prevent occupants from being unable to lock or unlock vehicle doors.

threats.threat_description: An attacker targets the Door ECU’s software update process by disabling or corrupting the update mechanism, preventing the installation of legitimate firmware patches that would restore secure token verification. This ensures that any malicious modifications to the firmware persist indefinitely, allowing the adversary to continuously issue unauthorized door lock/unlock commands.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door ECU shall enforce the Integrity, Authenticity, and Availability of the Door Lock/Unlock Command against ATM-T0021: Disable Software Update to prevent persistent unauthorized control of vehicle door locking functions.

threats.threat_description: An attacker sends forged start authorization tokens or commands on the CAN bus to the Start Authorization ECU to enable engine start without valid authentication.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of Engine Start Commands and Start Authorization Tokens against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized engine start and vehicle theft.

threats.threat_description: Modification of Start Authorization ECU firmware or configuration to bypass token verification and enable unauthorized engine start.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Integrity and Authenticity of the Engine Start Command and Start Authorization Token against ATM-T0022: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized engine start and vehicle theft.

threats.threat_description: Insufficient logging or lack of cryptographic proof may allow denial of start authorization by malicious parties or compromised ECUs.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Non-Repudiation of CAN bus start authorization messages against Modify Bus Message to prevent false denial or repudiation of start authorization events.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Test / Log Analysis / Message Authentication Verification

threats.threat_description: An attacker floods or jams the Start Authorization ECU communication or physically disables the powertrain interface, preventing legitimate engine starts.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Availability and Integrity of the Powertrain Start Interface and Engine Start Command against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent unauthorized denial of vehicle operation.

threats.threat_description: A compromised Start Authorization ECU could escalate privileges to issue start commands without valid tokens or bypass separation between body and powertrain domains.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the Powertrain Start Interface against ATM-T0024: Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism to prevent unauthorized engine start and bypass of domain separation.

threats.threat_description: An attacker forges start enable commands sent over the powertrain interface (DF10) to the Engine ECU / Inverter, enabling unauthorized engine start.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of start enable commands on the powertrain interface against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized engine start and vehicle theft.

threats.threat_description: An attacker blocks or jams the powertrain start interface (DF10) to prevent engine start despite valid authorization.
threats.atm_technique_name: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of the start command data flow between Start Authorization ECU and Engine ECU against Denial of Service on Vehicle Function to prevent unauthorized immobilization and user lockout.

threats.threat_description: An attacker with physical access to the CAN bus injects unauthorized lock/unlock or start commands to ECUs, exploiting the broadcast nature and potential lack of message-level authentication.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The CAN Bus shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of Lock/Unlock and Engine Start Messages against ATM-T0071: Unintended Vehicle Network Message to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or starting.

threats.threat_description: Manipulation of CAN messages in-transit to modify commands or tokens, causing unauthorized unlock or engine start.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The CAN Bus shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of CAN Lock/Unlock Messages against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and starting.

threats.threat_description: Flooding or jamming the CAN bus to disrupt communication between BCM, Door ECU, and Start Authorization ECU, causing denial of lock/unlock or engine start functionality.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The CAN Bus shall enforce the Availability and Integrity of In-Vehicle CAN (broadcast medium) against ATM-T0068: CAN Bus Denial of Service to prevent loss of lock/unlock and engine start functionality.

threats.threat_description: An attacker spoofs the HSM API responses or forges authorization tokens by compromising HSM firmware or API authentication mechanisms, leading to unauthorized unlock or start authorization.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Authenticity, Confidentiality, Integrity, and Availability of the Restricted HSM API, Start Authorization Token, and HSM Firmware / Secure Boot Measurements against ATM-T0075: Compromise Cryptographic Security to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or engine starting.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Firmware Analysis / API Authentication Validation

threats.threat_description: Tampering with HSM firmware or key store (KEYSTORE_1) to extract cryptographic keys or disable protections, enabling token forgery or key compromise.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Confidentiality, Integrity, Authenticity, and Availability of HSM Firmware / Secure Boot Measurements and Cryptographic Key Store against ATM-T0075: Compromise Cryptographic Security to prevent cryptographic key compromise, unauthorized ECU programming, and large-scale vehicle theft.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Firmware Integrity Verification / Secure Boot Validation

threats.threat_description: Lack of secure audit or attestation data (I10) may allow denial of unauthorized token generation or key access.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Accountability of HSM Attestation / Measurement Data against ATM-T0023: Modify Isolated Execution Environment to prevent loss of non-repudiation and inability to investigate unauthorized cryptographic operations.

threats.threat_description: Leakage of cryptographic keys or tokens via side channels or compromised firmware, exposing vehicle security credentials.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Store and HSM Firmware / Secure Boot Measurements against ATM-T0075: Compromise Cryptographic Security to prevent unauthorized extraction or misuse of vehicle security credentials and subsequent unauthorized vehicle access or control.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Side-Channel Analysis / Firmware Integrity Verification

threats.threat_description: Denial of service on the HSM API or crypto engine to prevent authentication or token generation, blocking door unlock or engine start.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of the Restricted HSM API against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent unauthorized blocking of door unlocking or engine starting.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Test / Fault Injection / Interface Load Testing

threats.threat_description: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in HSM firmware or API to gain unauthorized access to cryptographic operations or keys beyond intended restrictions.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Confidentiality, Integrity, Authenticity, and Availability of HSM Firmware / Secure Boot Measurements and Cryptographic Key Store against ATM-T0075: Compromise Cryptographic Security to prevent unauthorized access to cryptographic keys, unauthorized cryptographic operations, and compromise of secure boot or other security-critical functions.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Firmware and API Security Review

threats.threat_description: Compromise or leakage of the internal HSM communication bus (C8) between the Crypto Engine and Cryptographic Key Store could expose cryptographic key material or operation details to attackers, undermining key non-exportability and enabling token forgery.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of HSM Internal Bus / Key Access against ATM-T0038: Network Sniffing to prevent cryptographic key extraction and unauthorized token forgery.

threats.threat_description: An attacker tampers with the HSM internal bus (C8) to alter cryptographic operations or key access data, resulting in false verification outcomes or unauthorized token generation.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Confidentiality of HSM Internal Bus / Key Access against ATM-T0070: Modify Bus Message to prevent unauthorized cryptographic operations and compromise of vehicle system security.

threats.threat_description: Attacks that block or disrupt the internal HSM bus (C8) prevent the Crypto Engine from accessing keys in the Key Store, causing authentication failures and denial of unlock/start functionality.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of HSM Internal Bus / Key Access against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent denial of unlock and start functionality.

threats.threat_description: Manipulation or spoofing of the HSM attestation and measurement data flow (DF18) from the HSM to the BCM could mislead the BCM into trusting a compromised or unauthorized HSM state, undermining system security assurances.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Confidentiality of attestation and measurement data on data flow DF18 against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent the BCM from trusting a compromised or unauthorized HSM state.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Data Flow Integrity Verification

threats.threat_description: Blocking or jamming the HSM attestation and measurement flow (DF18) prevents the BCM from verifying the HSM’s integrity, potentially allowing compromised HSM operation to go undetected.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the attestation and measurement flow between HSM_1 and BCM_1 against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent undetected operation of a compromised HSM and subsequent unauthorized vehicle control.

threats.threat_description: An attacker intercepts and analyzes the HSM attestation data (DF18) to gain insights into firmware versions or security state, aiding targeted attacks against vulnerable HSM firmware.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of Attestation Data exchanged between HSM_1 and BCM_1 against ATM-T0038: Network Sniffing to prevent attacker reconnaissance of firmware version or security state that could enable targeted exploitation.

threats.threat_description: An attacker gains unauthorized local access to the HSM's secure enclave environment and uses command-line tools or scripts to extract sensitive attestation data and firmware metadata stored in local logs and configuration files. By parsing these local files, the attacker obtains detailed insights into the HSM's security state and firmware versions, which can be leveraged to craft targeted exploits against known vulnerabilities within the secure enclave.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM / Secure Enclave shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of attestation data and firmware metadata against ATM-T0059: Data from Local System to prevent unauthorized disclosure and manipulation that could enable targeted exploitation of known vulnerabilities.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Log and File Access Analysis

threats.threat_description: Tampering with the crypto engine to return false verification results or generate forged tokens, bypassing authentication.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Crypto Engine shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, Confidentiality, and Availability of the Start Authorization Token and Cryptographic Key Store against ATM-T0075: Compromise Cryptographic Security to prevent unauthorized vehicle start or access.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Fault Injection / Firmware Analysis

threats.threat_description: Extraction of cryptographic key material during internal processing or via side channels within the crypto engine.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Crypto Engine shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of the Cryptographic Key Store against ATM-T0027: Exploit Isolated Execution Environment Vulnerability to prevent unauthorized extraction of key material and subsequent compromise of cryptographic operations.

threats.threat_description: Interruption or blocking of the data flow (DF12) where the Crypto Engine accesses keys from the Cryptographic Key Store prevents cryptographic operations, leading to denial of authentication and token generation.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Crypto Engine shall ensure the Availability and Authenticity of cryptographic key retrieval operations between CRYPTO_ENG_1 and KEYSTORE_1 against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent failure of authentication and token generation processes.

threats.threat_description: An attacker with access to the diagnostic interface exploits the standard diagnostic protocol's WriteMemoryByAddress service to directly modify the crypto engine's RAM contents during runtime. By overwriting verification keys stored temporarily in RAM or altering the execution stack, the attacker causes the crypto engine to generate forged Start Authorization Tokens or bypass cryptographic verification without altering persistent firmware. This manipulation enables unauthorized access without detection, as the changes are transient and revert after power cycle, evading traditional integrity checks.
threats.atm_technique_name: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol to Temporarily Modify Execution

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Crypto Engine shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Confidentiality of the Start Authorization Token and Cryptographic Key Store against ATM-T0074: Abuse Standard Diagnostic Protocol to Temporarily Modify Execution to prevent unauthorized vehicle start or access.

threats.threat_description: Extraction or leakage of cryptographic keys stored within the key store, enabling attackers to forge tokens or impersonate the key fob or vehicle.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Cryptographic Key Store shall protect the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0040: Unsecured Credentials to prevent unauthorized vehicle access, engine start, or impersonation of the key fob or vehicle.

threats.threat_description: Modification or deletion of keys or key metadata, causing denial of authentication or enabling unauthorized access.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Cryptographic Key Store shall enforce the Integrity, Availability, Confidentiality, and Authenticity of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0070: Modify Bus Message to prevent unauthorized access to vehicle functions or denial of authentication for legitimate users.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Test / Storage and Communication Channel Analysis

threats.threat_description: An attacker reverse engineers malware that uses a hardcoded cryptographic key to encrypt command and control traffic targeting the cryptographic key store. By extracting this key from the malware sample, the attacker decrypts intercepted communications and gains unauthorized access to the cryptographic key material, enabling them to forge tokens or impersonate legitimate vehicle components.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Cryptographic Key Store shall protect the Confidentiality, Authenticity, and Integrity of Cryptographic Key Material against ATM-T0066: Standard Cryptographic Protocol to prevent unauthorized access, token forgery, or impersonation of vehicle components.

threats.threat_description: Physical tampering or sabotage of the door lock actuator to prevent locking or unlocking commands from being executed properly.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door Lock Actuator shall enforce the Availability and Integrity of Door Lock/Unlock Command against ATM-T0016: Physical Modification to prevent unauthorized access or denial of entry to the vehicle.

threats.threat_description: Physical disabling or jamming of the actuator to block door locking or unlocking, denying legitimate access.
threats.atm_technique_name: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Door Lock Actuator shall enforce the Availability of Door Lock/Unlock Command against ATM-T0072: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function to prevent legitimate users from being denied access to or unable to secure the vehicle.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Physical Penetration Testing / Functional Robustness Test

threats.threat_description: Modification of engine ECU firmware or configuration to ignore start authorization commands or enable unauthorized engine start.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Engine ECU / Inverter shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of Engine Start Command against ATM-T0022: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent unauthorized engine start and vehicle theft.

threats.threat_description: Disruption of the powertrain interface or physical tampering to prevent engine start despite valid authorization.
threats.atm_technique_name: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Engine ECU / Inverter shall enforce the Availability and Integrity of the Engine Start Command against ATM-T0072: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function to prevent unauthorized immobilization of the vehicle despite valid authorization.

threats.threat_description: An attacker injects false LF wake/proximity events to the BCM, causing repeated or unauthorized challenge-response initiations.
linked_assets: LF Receiver -> BCM Event / Control Link
threats.atm_technique_name: Reprogram Co-Located Computing Device for Privilege Escalation

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Receiver / LF Front-End shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of the LF Receiver to BCM Event / Control Link against ATM-T0030: Reprogram Co-Located Computing Device for Privilege Escalation to prevent unauthorized challenge-response initiations, relay attacks, and denial of service to the keyless entry/start system.

threats.threat_description: Compromise or manipulation of the LF receiver hardware or firmware to generate false events or block legitimate LF detection.
linked_assets: LF Receiver -> BCM Event / Control Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Receiver / LF Front-End shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of BCM Event / Control Link against ATM-T0016: Physical Modification to prevent unauthorized vehicle access or denial of entry/start to legitimate users.

threats.threat_description: Blocking or jamming of LF signals or disabling the LF receiver to prevent legitimate proximity detection and thereby denying access.
linked_assets: LF Receiver -> BCM Event / Control Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Receiver / LF Front-End shall enforce the Availability of the LF Receiver -> BCM Event / Control Link against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent denial of legitimate vehicle access and starting.

threats.threat_description: Relay attacks exploiting the Wireless Communication Boundary (TB1) by capturing and forwarding LF or RF signals between the key fob and vehicle, effectively extending the key fob’s range to unlock or start the vehicle without authorization. This spans ANT_1, ANT_RF_1, RF_1, EXT_1, and communication assets C1, C2, C10, and C15.
linked_assets: RF Transceiver -> Vehicle Antenna RF Link

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Wireless Communication Interface shall enforce the Authenticity and Confidentiality of LF Proximity Signals and RF Challenge-Response Messages against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking and starting.

threats.threat_description: Cross-component firmware compromise or manipulation where the RF transceiver firmware (I7) and BCM firmware (I3) are attacked to disable authentication checks, allowing forged tokens or commands to propagate through the system undetected. This affects RF_1, BCM_1, and HSM_1 components and their associated assets.
threats.atm_technique_name: Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver, BCM, and HSM shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, Confidentiality, and Availability of their Firmware and Secure Boot Measurements against Modify OS Kernel, Boot Partition, or System Partition to prevent persistent unauthorized access, remote vehicle control, and compromise of cryptographic trust anchors.

threats.threat_description: Lack of centralized, tamper-proof logging of authentication events and commands across BCM, HSM, Door ECU, and Start Authorization ECU could allow attackers or compromised nodes to deny malicious actions such as unauthorized unlocks or engine starts.
threats.atm_technique_name: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module, Hardware Security Module, Door ECU, and Start Authorization ECU shall enforce the Integrity, Authenticity, and Accountability of authentication event and critical command logs against ATM-T0072: Denial of Service on Vehicle Function to prevent repudiation of unauthorized unlocks or engine starts.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Test / Log Integrity Verification / Forensic Audit

threats.threat_description: Eavesdropping or side-channel leakage of cryptographic keys or tokens on internal communication buses (CAN bus, restricted HSM API) or via compromised ECU firmware, exposing sensitive authentication material across BCM, HSM, and ECUs.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module, Hardware Security Module, and Electronic Control Units shall protect the Confidentiality, Authenticity, and Integrity of Cryptographic Key Material and Start Authorization Tokens against ATM-T0038: Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized vehicle start, immobilizer bypass, and key cloning.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Interface Monitoring / Side-Channel Analysis

threats.threat_description: Coordinated jamming or flooding attacks on LF and RF communication channels (C1, C2), CAN bus (C7), or API calls (C4) to prevent authentication flows, lock/unlock commands, or engine start, denying legitimate vehicle usage.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Keyless Entry and Start System shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of LF Proximity Signal, RF Challenge-Response Messages, In-Vehicle CAN, and Restricted HSM API against Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent legitimate vehicle users from being denied lock/unlock or engine start functionality.

threats.threat_description: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in the restricted HSM API (C4) or BCM firmware (I3) to escalate privileges and bypass cryptographic key usage restrictions, enabling unauthorized token generation or key extraction affecting BCM, HSM, and related assets.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module and Hardware Security Module shall enforce the Confidentiality, Integrity, and Authenticity of the Restricted HSM API, BCM Firmware, and Cryptographic Key Store against Abuse Elevation Control Mechanism to prevent unauthorized token generation or cryptographic key extraction that could compromise vehicle security functions.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Interface Fuzzing / Code Review

threats.threat_description: Compromise or manipulation of the RF receive metadata (C11) generated by the RF front-end allows an attacker to eavesdrop on or infer sensitive signal characteristics such as RSSI and timestamps, potentially aiding relay or spoofing attacks by revealing timing or signal strength information used in authentication decisions.

An attacker manipulates or spoofs the RF receive metadata (C11) provided to the BCM or HSM, causing incorrect signal strength or timing data to influence authentication decisions, potentially allowing relay or replay attacks to succeed undetected.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module and Hardware Security Module shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of RF receive metadata (RSSI/timestamp) against Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or starting due to undetected relay or replay attacks.

threats.threat_description: Blocking or corrupting the RF receive metadata (C11) flow prevents the BCM or HSM from obtaining accurate signal measurements, causing authentication failures or denial of service.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module and Hardware Security Module shall ensure the Availability and Authenticity of RF receive metadata (RSSI/timestamp) against Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent authentication failures and denial of service for keyless entry or start functions.

threats.threat_description: An attacker extracts or manipulates the diagram's message annotations (I6), which document security-related annotations on messages, to misinterpret or hide critical security metadata leading to incorrect threat assessments or bypassing security controls that rely on these annotations.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The System Development Environment shall enforce the Integrity and Authenticity of Message Annotations (diagram labels) against ATM-T0003: Manipulate Communications to prevent deployment of systems with weakened or missing security controls.

threats.threat_description: An attacker injects or replays false LF proximity trigger signals on the data flow DF1 from the LF Antenna (Door Handle) to the Key Fob, causing the key fob to respond unnecessarily or enabling unauthorized challenge initiations.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Antenna (Door Handle) and Key Fob shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of LF Proximity Trigger Signals on data flow DF1 against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or challenge initiation.

threats.threat_description: An attacker jams or blocks the LF proximity trigger signal data flow DF1, preventing the key fob from detecting proximity and denying legitimate access.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The LF Antenna subsystem shall enforce the Availability of the LF proximity trigger signal between ANT_1 and EXT_1 against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent denial of legitimate keyless entry and start functions.

threats.threat_description: An attacker eavesdrops on the LF proximity trigger signal data flow DF1 to gather timing or usage patterns that may assist in subsequent relay or spoofing attacks.

An attacker intercepts and modifies or replays the RF challenge messages on data flow DF2 from the RF Transceiver to the Key Fob, potentially causing the key fob to respond incorrectly or enabling relay attacks.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver and Key Fob shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of RF challenge messages on data flow DF2 against Manipulate Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or starting via relay or replay attacks.

threats.threat_description: An attacker jams or blocks the RF challenge data flow DF2 preventing the key fob from receiving the challenge, denying authentication.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Communication Module shall enforce the Availability of RF Challenge Data Flow (DF2) against Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent legitimate users from being denied vehicle access or operation.

threats.threat_description: An attacker eavesdrops on the RF challenge data flow DF2 to collect challenge nonces and session identifiers, potentially aiding cryptanalysis or replay attacks.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Communication Interface shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of challenge nonces and session identifiers against Network Sniffing to prevent replay attacks and unauthorized access to the vehicle.

threats.threat_description: An attacker captures and replays or forges RF response messages on data flow DF3 from the Key Fob to the RF Transceiver, attempting to impersonate the key fob and gain unauthorized access.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of RF Authentication Messages of RF_1 against ATM-T0007: Relay Communications to prevent unauthorized vehicle entry and engine start.

threats.threat_description: An attacker modifies the RF response messages on data flow DF3 to alter authentication data, potentially causing verification failures or unauthorized access.
threats.atm_technique_name: Reprogram Co-Located Computing Device for Privilege Escalation

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Communication Module shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of authentication data on data flow EXT_1 -> RF_1 against ATM-T0030: Reprogram Co-Located Computing Device for Privilege Escalation to prevent unauthorized vehicle access or denial of legitimate access.

threats.threat_description: An attacker blocks or jams the RF response messages on data flow DF3, preventing authentication and denying vehicle access.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Communication Interface shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of authentication messages on data flow EXT_1 -> RF_1 against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent denial of legitimate vehicle access.

threats.threat_description: An attacker compromises the RF transceiver or intercepts data flow DF6 to modify or drop forwarded authentication data, causing false authentication or denial of service.
threats.atm_technique_name: Reprogram Co-Located Computing Device for Privilege Escalation

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF Transceiver shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Availability of authentication data between the Key Fob and Body Control Module against Reprogram Co-Located Computing Device for Privilege Escalation to prevent unauthorized vehicle access or denial of service.

threats.threat_description: An attacker eavesdrops on the forwarded authentication data on data flow DF6 revealing cryptographic response information.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The RF_1 and BCM_1 shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of authentication data against ATM-T0038: Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized access or replay attacks on vehicle entry and start functions.

threats.threat_description: An attacker blocks or jams data flow DF6, preventing the BCM from receiving authentication data and denying vehicle access.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module shall enforce the Availability of the wireless communication channel between the Remote Key Fob and the Body Control Module against Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent denial of vehicle access for authorized users.

threats.threat_description: An attacker intercepts or modifies restricted API calls on data flow DF7 from the BCM to the HSM, altering verification requests or bypassing authentication checks.
threats.atm_technique_name: Reprogram Co-Located Computing Device for Privilege Escalation

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module and Hardware Security Module shall enforce the Authenticity, Integrity, and Confidentiality of restricted API calls on data flow DF7 against ATM-T0030: Reprogram Co-Located Computing Device for Privilege Escalation to prevent unauthorized key management, immobilizer bypass, or cryptographic function misuse.

threats.threat_description: An attacker eavesdrops on the restricted HSM API calls on data flow DF7 to extract sensitive verification data or context.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module and Hardware Security Module shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of restricted HSM API call data on data flow DF7 against Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized extraction of sensitive verification data or operational context.

threats.threat_description: An attacker blocks or jams the restricted API calls on data flow DF7, preventing the HSM from performing cryptographic verification and denying authentication.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module shall enforce the Availability and Authenticity of cryptographic authentication services on the BCM_1 to HSM_1 interface against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent unauthorized denial of secure unlock, start authorization, or firmware update functions.

threats.threat_description: An attacker modifies or forges cryptographic verification results or authorization tokens on data flow DF8 from the HSM to the BCM, enabling unauthorized unlock or engine start commands.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The Body Control Module (BCM) shall enforce the Authenticity and Integrity of cryptographic verification results and authorization tokens received from the Hardware Security Module (HSM) against ATM-T0070: Modify Bus Message to prevent unauthorized vehicle unlocking or engine start.
cybersecurity_goal.verification_method: Penetration Testing / Protocol Message Integrity Verification

threats.threat_description: An attacker eavesdrops on verification results and authorization tokens on data flow DF8, potentially gaining sensitive information about authentication status or cryptographic tokens.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM_1 to BCM_1 communication channel shall protect the Confidentiality and Authenticity of verification results and authorization tokens against Network Sniffing to prevent unauthorized disclosure or misuse of authentication information.

threats.threat_description: An attacker blocks or jams data flow DF8, preventing the BCM from receiving verification results or tokens, denying unlock or engine start functionality.

cybersecurity_goal.csg_statement: The HSM_1 to BCM_1 communication channel shall ensure the Availability and Authenticity of cryptographic verification data against ATM-T0002: Jamming or Denial of Service to prevent denial of keyless entry and engine start functionality.
